observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== keycloak-bootstrap exit code ==="
docker inspect --format '{{.State.ExitCode}}' workspace-keycloak-bootstrap-1
echo "=== keycloak-bootstrap log tail ==="
docker logs workspace-keycloak-bootstrap-1 2>&1 | tail -8
echo "=== MinIO buckets (via mc) ==="
# use env creds from .env
source <(grep -E "^(S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID|S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)=" .env)
docker run --rm --network workspace_default minio/mc:latest \
  alias set local http://minio:9000 "$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" >/dev/null 2>&1
docker run --rm --network workspace_default minio/mc:latest --config-dir /tmp/mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "--- list buckets ---"
docker run --rm -v /tmp/mcdata:/root/.mc --network workspace_default minio/mc:latest alias set local http://minio:9000 "$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" >/dev/null 2>&1
